 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Will Smith on Moving Off Celebrini's Line to Skate With Michael Misa vs. Sabres Sharks forward Will Smith meets the media at morning skate before San Jose hosts the Buffalo Sabres. He talks about getting split from Macklin Celebrini to give another line a spark, and about his new linemates after one practice together. Smith calls Michael Misa one of the team's best skaters and says the line does its best work on the forecheck, forcing turnovers. He also covers getting home after a long road trip, adjusting the lineup around injuries, and a Sabres team that made the second round last year. 2:46 Now Playing Paused Ad Playing
